title: I have a recurring dream of a waterpark/high school
content: i’ve had this dream on more than one occasion where i’m in a very busy waterpark that also doubles as a high school. it’s an indoor-outdoor complex loaded with people. i will frequently run into people i know when i have this dream. one time my best friend approached me through the dream crowd and handed me a sword and shield while saying “here, you’re going to need this”. i mentioned this dream to said friend and she confirmed “oh yeah, i’ve definitely been to waterpark high school” has anyone else dreamed of this location?
